component.title: HTML Component for the icon.
component.description:
This HTML Componen uses `fetch` to retrive the icons
```js
fetch("/icons/{icon_name}.svg")
```

icons.title: Icons of your choise
icons.description: The Map that holds your icons

icon.title: Default Icon
icon.description: Set your `icon` if the component HTML attribute is empty. Example `home`

kind.title: Default Kind
kind.description: Set your `kind` if the component HTML attribute is empty. Options are `fill, stroke`

name.title: Component Name
name.description:
> Info: all `Custom Component API` components require an `-` in the name
Set your HTML Component name like `ui-icons`

size.title: Default Size
size.description: Set your `size` if the component HTML attribute is empty. Example `24px`

icon.title: Icon Name
icon.description: Info: For icons like google (mdi) you need to specify the category like `action/123`

kind.title: Icon Kind
kind.description: Set the icon kind. For example tabler has two kinds `filled, outline`
